implementation_strategy: Execute a single hosted-adapter run (hosted_netops_gvr_v1) calling openai_responses:gpt-5-mini. Use the preregistered sampling script and RNG seeds to deterministically select tasks 1..240. For each task: 1 shared initial generation call (shared_initial_candidate semantics) and, if the deterministic verifier fails that candidate under the guarded flow, at most one bounded repair call (generate_validate_repair_v1) per task. All verification is deterministic (pybatfish-based verifier) and automated; scoring uses the adapter's paired_binary_episode_v1 schema. All calls, prompts, seeds, verifier diagnostics, diffs, and hashes are logged. Execution runs in four sequential Docker-hosted batches to respect wall-clock constraints and allow deterministic replay; no human scoring or adjudication is used.
public_resources: Public synthetic NetOps task bank v1 (release subset; 12 clusters × 20 tasks = 240 tasks)
Deterministic verifier: pybatfish-based checks (reachability, ACL violation lists, explicit counterexample flows)
Execution harness and scorer (hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter implementation repo)
model_and_version_plan: openai_responses / gpt-5-mini (model_name=gpt-5-mini, model_version=gpt-5-mini) — single-model, single-version for all calls
task_manifest_strategy: Use archived preregistered RNG seeds and deterministic task-selection code to generate the exact ordered manifest of 240 tasks. Archive manifest and hash before any model calls.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Apply baseline transformation 'direct_configuration_generation_v1' and guarded transformation 'generate_validate_repair_v1' per adapter contract. Guarded repair: at most one repair attempt per failing verifier check; repairs bounded by the adapter's edit budget rules.
randomisation_plan: No randomisation at run-time. All RNG seeds and any stochastic choices are preregistered and archived to ensure determinism in task selection and batching.
caching_plan: Cache and immutably store every model request/response and every verifier output. Replays use cached artifacts; cached artifacts used only for deterministic replays or infrastructure-failure recovery, not to alter scientific selection or exclude failed pairs.
failure_recovery_plan: Technical retries permitted only for infrastructure/API errors: 1 immediate retry per failed call, then a single scheduled retry for transient provider issues (max 2 attempts total). All retries logged with timestamps and reason. Pairs with irrecoverable infra/provider failures are flagged per preregistered 'complete_pair_primary' rules and included in conservative sensitivity analysis treating them as violations.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (version 1.0): per-task paired outcome records for baseline vs guarded (verifier-detected semantic violation: boolean for each arm), verifier diagnostics, repair transcripts/diffs, flags (timeout, edit-budget-exceeded), and execution metadata (timestamps, model-call ids, seeds, hashes).
estimated_compute_notes: Model-call estimate: maximum_model_calls = task_count * 2 = 240 * 2 = 480 calls. Per-call max_output_tokens = 2000 → worst-case token ceiling = 480 * 2000 = 960,000 output tokens. All calls use hosted API (openai_responses:gpt-5-mini). No local GPU required. Expected wall-clock execution ≤ 7 days using 4 sequential batches and parallel host-managed API concurrency within adapter limits.
